collateral: USDT-denominated Morpho lending positions through a MorphoMarketV1AdapterV2, collateralized mainly by sUSDS with a small cbBTC position; not directly held borrower collateral.
pegMechanism: Deposit USDT to mint ERC-4626 lending-vault shares. Accrued lending interest increases USDT per share; ordinary redemption burns shares for idle USDT and available liquidity from the selected adapter's wstETH/USDT market. Borrower defaults, collateral liquidation and vault fees affect share value. VaultV2 maxWithdraw/maxRedeem always return zero as conservative underestimates, not measured exit capacity; force-deallocation is a separate path subject to underlying liquidity. At the reviewed pin, the current adapter's force-deallocation penalty is 0% of assets deallocated; this separate route still requires market liquidity and is not an ordinary withdrawal fee.
